description: Import campaign or creative-level spend rows.

account_ref.description: Optional reference of the ad account the spend belongs to.

completeness.description: final when the network has settled these days; partial when it is still updating them. Either way, a newer import of a row with the same campaign, ad set, ad and day replaces the earlier one in reports; a campaign-level row and an ad-level row for one campaign and day are both kept and reported as spend_grain_conflict. The API uses partial when omitted.

covers_from.description: First day the batch covers, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Every row's metric_date must fall between covers_from and covers_to.

covers_to.description: Last day the batch covers, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on or after covers_from.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of every amount in rows, for example USD.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

network.description: The ad network the spend was paid to.

notes.description: Optional free-text note stored with the batch.

report_timezone.description: Timezone of the network report the rows come from. The API uses UTC when omitted.

rows.description: The spend rows, 1 to 5,000: one per campaign and day, or per campaign, ad set, ad and day.

ad_id.description: Ad id. Must be sent together with adset_id; either one alone is rejected.

ad_name.description: Optional ad name, as the network reports it.

adset_id.description: Ad set id. Must be sent together with ad_id; either one alone is rejected.

adset_name.description: Optional ad set name, as the network reports it.

campaign_id.description: The AttriKit campaign UUID, NOT the ad network's own campaign id (that is create_campaign_link.network_campaign_id). It is the most common mistake here: read it from list_campaigns. The API rejects a network id by name. Preferred snake_case spelling.

clicks.description: Clicks the network reported for this row. The API stores 0 when omitted.

impressions.description: Impressions the network reported for this row. The API stores 0 when omitted.

metric_date.description: Required metric date. Preferred snake_case spelling.

spend_minor_units.description: Required spend amount. Preferred snake_case spelling.

source.description: Where the rows came from: network_api, csv or manual. The API uses manual when omitted.

name: import_spend
title: Import ad spend
